note: Guide: gradients belong to progress components only, never cards or other elements (757-760); colour is never decoration (COLOR-02). Every form fieldset gets a primary left rule and a primary/5 gradient. Legend text-lg semibold matches 470/4034.

Guide sets form field spacing at mb-3 (2397, SPACE-01); the horizontal wrapper has no bottom margin, so stacked horizontal fields touch unless the caller spaces them. Error label also drops lg:mr-2 (119), shifting the column on error.

Guide (2571) says the input's aria-label is "Add a callsign"; the field passes aria_label: nil (_callsign_chips.html.erb:15) so the visible label names it instead. Code is defensible; guide text is stale.

Guide comment (2503) promises a 120px minimum height; the field is "textarea w-full resize-y" and daisyUI 5's textarea sets min-height 5rem (80px). No CSS in components/ raises it. Default w-full is also wider than the width table suggests.

Guide: required: shows the marker and adds the required attribute for all fields (2462). check_box consumes required: and renders neither. Also, in horizontal/auto layout label: becomes an unassociated <span> (881-883, 906-908), leaving the box unnamed without inline_label (FORM-02, high).

Guide: the 36px class goes on the wrapping <label> of a checkbox or radio (579). The radio sits outside its label; the label has min-h-9 but the radio-sm itself is about 20px. required: is also dropped (FORM-03).

Guide: radio groups get a fieldset with legend (2403, 2589). Vertical and :stacked do; horizontal/auto inline name the group with a plain <span>, so the group has no accessible name. Items repeat the radio-outside-label TOUCH-01 gap; sm:columns-2 breaks BP-01.

Guide: red asterisk plus screen-reader text "(required)" (2400, 2710). Default prints visible "(required)" in text-xs (TYPE-02 bans text-xs on labels); required_label: "" prints an asterisk with no text alternative. Neither variant matches.
TYPE-02 bans text-xs on labels a reader needs; the "(required)" marker inside every required label is text-xs. Line 816 is text-sm icon sizing and is fine.

Guide: help text tied by aria-describedby (2711), help_mode :tooltip documented (2464). Inline mode complies (text-sm text-body). Tooltip mode puts help only in a title on an unfocusable span while aria-describedby names a "_hint" id that is never rendered.
Guide puts the 36px class on the wrapping label of a radio (579); check_box (933) wraps correctly, radio_button's label is a sibling and the small radio is outside it.
pattern=forms sm: is allowed only in a field width:; horizontal collection radios step column count at sm:columns-2, a layout tier below lg.

Guide: a bulleted list is list-bulleted (556-568). The summary's <ul class="mt-2 space-y-1"> draws its own bullets with an • span per item. Otherwise COMPLIANT FORM-06: ui_callout_box :error at the top, role=alert, focusable id.
Bulleted lists are list-bulleted; form_error_summary's ul draws bullet spans by hand.
Guide: the first error field receives focus automatically. Code: focuses #form-error-summary first and only falls back to the first errored field when no summary exists.
